features: VERSATILE RECORDING: 2K HD action camera with 170-degree wide-angle lens, featuring multiple shooting modes including Photo, Video, and Time-lapse for diverse capture options
WATERPROOF DESIGN: Durable waterproof construction perfect for outdoor adventures like surfing, hiking, and biking, with operating temperature up to 45 degrees Celsius
ADVANCED FEATURES: Electronic image stabilisation, 16x digital zoom, 5x optical zoom, and fixed focus system for clear, steady footage in various conditions
DISPLAY & STORAGE: 2-inch display with 1920p resolution, compatible with Micro SD cards (Class 10), supporting MP4 video and JPEG image formats
CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS: Built-in Wi-Fi (802.11 BGN), USB 2.0 connectivity, and smartphone compatibility for easy file transfer and remote control
description: Capture your thrilling adventures in stunning detail with this VYNEX HD 2K Action Camera. This compact and durable sports camcorder boasts a 170-degree wide-angle lens, perfect for recording expansive views during your outdoor pursuits. With 1080p video resolution and 16MP still photos, every moment is preserved in crisp clarity. The camera's waterproof design makes it ideal for surfing, swimming, and water sports. Features include electronic image stabilisation for smooth footage, built-in Wi-Fi for easy sharing, and a 2-inch display for convenient preview and playback. The versatile mounting system accommodates various activities like biking and hiking. Supporting both photo and time-lapse modes, this action camera comes equipped with a rechargeable lithium-ion battery. The device accepts Micro SD cards (Class 10) and connects via USB 2.0 for seamless file transfer. With its lightweight design at just 150 grams and compact dimensions of 6.5 x 5.0 x 4.5 centimetres, this camera is the perfect companion for documenting your outdoor adventures.
